name: Red Star Wrestling Championship
epitaph: The fed's own title: its 7 April 2009 news ties the Red Star Wrestling Championship to 100% ownership of the company in a Scaffold Ladder Match, and records it vacated the same day; its champions page reads Vacant. Its title-history page holds only a heading.

name: Red Star Wrestling Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's tag title, held by Team Ego on its champions page, with a 7 April 2009 statement from the new owner that he would decide whether their win stood. Its tag title-history page holds only a heading.
